title: Deep-sky catalogs
intro: Deep-sky catalogs to add to the one included with StarLight (OpenNGC, Messier, Caldwell). The objects of an installed catalog are recognized in the field, marked on the image and can be found by designation. They contain only data under an open license: you download them from the StarLight server or install them from a ZIP archive, and they are checked before installation. The star package for plate solving, instead, lets StarLight recognize the framed sky even without an internet connection.
limitMagnitudeTitle: Magnitude of the faintest star included in the package
exampleTitle: How designations are written in this catalog

status.activeTitle: Its objects are recognized and marked on the image
status.activeStarsTitle: Plate solving uses these stars before turning to the online Gaia catalog
status.disabledTitle: Installed but not used: its objects are not recognized
status.disabledStarsTitle: Installed but not used: plate solving only uses the online Gaia catalog
status.fromFileTitle: Installed from an archive, not available on the server

actions.uninstallTitle: Removes the catalog from StarLight by deleting its folder
actions.uninstallStarsTitle: Removes the package from StarLight by deleting its folder
actions.disableTitle: The catalog stays on disk but its objects are no longer used, including the next time you open StarLight, until you enable it again
actions.disableStarsTitle: The package stays on disk but plate solving no longer uses it, including the next time you open StarLight, until you enable it again
actions.enableTitle: Its objects are recognized and marked on the image again
actions.enableStarsTitle: Plate solving uses these stars again
